# Tidy

A shared chores board for people who live together.

## Why

Flatmates argue about chores because nobody can see who did what. A shared
board that rotates chores fairly removes the argument.

## Who

- **For:** students and young professionals sharing a flat (3 to 6 people)
- **Built by:** one developer with AI coding agents

## Now

- Nothing built yet. This fixture exists to test the validator.
